## Observable JS

Quarto natively supports [Observable JS](https://observablehq.com/) for interactive visualizations and analysis in the browser. OJS in Quarto is documented [here](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/index.html#observable-js).

### Read CSV

Specify `ojs` as the language. Read a CSV file as an array of row objects.

````
```{{ojs}}
data = FileAttachment("assets/diamonds.csv").csv({ typed: true})
data
```
````

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("assets/diamonds.csv").csv({ typed: true})
data
```

### Table

Display the data as a table.

```{ojs}
viewof raw_table = Inputs.table(data)
```

### Scatterplot

Select variables for point color and the x- and y-axes.

::: {.alert .alert-secondary}

```{ojs}
viewof col = Inputs.select(["carat","cut","color","clarity","depth","table","price"],{value: "cut", multiple: false, label: "Color"})
viewof x = Inputs.select(["carat","depth","table","price"], {value: "carat", multiple: false, label: "X axis"})
viewof y = Inputs.select(["carat","depth","table","price"], {value: "depth", multiple: false, label: "Y axis"})
```

:::

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-scatter-1
//| fig-cap: Scatterplot A.

Plot.plot({
  color: {legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(data, {
      x: x,
      y: y,
      stroke: col,
      title: (d) => `${d.cut}`
    })
  ],
  grid: true
})
```

## Mermaid

Quarto natively supports diagrams using [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/). Using Mermaid in Quarto is documented [here](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/diagrams.html).

### Flowchart

Specify `mermaid` as the language.

````
```{{mermaid}}
flowchart LR
  A[Hard edge] --> B(Round edge)
  B --> C{Decision}
  C --> D[Result one]
  C --> E[Result two]
```
````

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
flowchart LR
  A[Hard edge] --> B(Round edge)
  B --> C{Decision}
  C --> D[Result one]
  C --> E[Result two]
```

### Gantt charts

````
```{{mermaid}}
gantt
    title A Gantt Diagram
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Section
        A task          :a1, 2014-01-01, 30d
        Another task    :after a1, 20d
    section Another
        Task in Another :2014-01-12, 12d
        another task    :24d
```
````

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
gantt
    title A Gantt Diagram
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Section
        A task          :a1, 2014-01-01, 30d
        Another task    :after a1, 20d
    section Another
        Task in Another :2014-01-12, 12d
        another task    :24d
```
